contract.launch: LAUNCHING/source dependency commits before log/process/lease effects. Actual evaluator.prepare_supervised preserves true worker PID. READY proof and phase-qualified compute start are verified inside the lease; RUNNING pins complete READY before successful lease exit. Fresh launch/GPU/runtime/campaign/stop/source/current gates precede GO.
contract.publication: wait accepts only complete shared-supervisor closure. Exact closure is checked before and inside the terminal writer; full process_tree is recorded in effect plan and terminal. Actual worker code is preserved; STOP0 is not success. Source dependency remains watched without rewriting its lifecycle.
contract.failure: One timeout STOP; no retry after unknown STOP. Known returned supervised handles are cleaned based on the tree, not a leader-only raw PID. Preparation/loss uncertainty retains nonterminal HOLD and cannot fabricate NOT_STARTED. If safe cleanup confirms the tree after an initialization error, the action still remains operational HOLD rather than inventing successful delivery.
contract.scope: Only source-bound native post-scripts. Arbitrary user script/data/output paths are not sandboxed or auto-registered scientific artifacts; no adoption, runtime reconnect, new observations or CPU research policy is implemented.
